---
title: "Format test (.qmd)"
---

The Quarto options. These need a Quarto renderer: the Quarto extension's Preview (Cmd+Shift+K), Positron, or `quarto preview reference/plan/format_test.qmd`. VS Code's plain Markdown preview won't render them. Options 1–15 are in `format_test.md`; the same ones work here too.

## 16. Quarto callouts, all five kinds

::: {.callout-note title="Claude"}
A note callout (blue).
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Your response"}
A tip callout (green).
:::

::: {.callout-important title="Your response"}
An important callout (red).
:::

::: {.callout-warning title="Your response"}
A warning callout (orange).
:::

::: {.callout-caution title="Your response"}
A caution callout (orange).
:::
